{"code": "from itertools import product

# Use stratified analysis: compute conversion rate difference within each customer segment
stratified_results = []

for segment in sales_df['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    conv_email = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    conv_paid_search = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff_strat = conv_email - conv_paid_search
    n_email = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
    n_paid_search = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
    
    stratified_results.append({
        'segment': segment,
        'diff': diff_strat,
        'n_email': n_email,
        'n_paid_search': n_paid_search,
        'conv_email': conv_email,
        'conv_paid_search': conv_paid_search
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
stratified_df = pd.DataFrame(stratified_results)
print(stratified_df)"}
